comment: How much of the script generation chain refuses to derive a Defold revision other than the pinned one. Measured by scripts/check-cross-revision-derivation.mjs. This number only goes DOWN: a change that makes more steps refuse fails the check with the new refusals named. Nothing in `pnpm check` can find these, because `pnpm check` generates the one revision every pinned assumption was written against.
controlRationale: A stable release that differs from the pinned dev revision along the axes that matter: no bullet3d backend at all, zero ---@alias declarations against the pinned revision's 98, callbacks annotated in the older `function(...)` spelling, and the editor and Lua standard-library surfaces the pinned revision omits.
